title: QWEN3 just BROKE the AI Industry...

comments.author: @-Evil-Genius-
comments.text:
Brief:
- Qwen 3 is a new Chinese open-source AI model that competes with top-tier models like DeepSeek R1 and Gemini 2.5 Pro.
- The flagship Qwen 3 model, with 235 billion parameters, uses a "mixture of experts" approach, activating different parts of the model based on the query.
- The model supports both thinking and non-thinking modes, allowing for deep reasoning or fast responses depending on the task.
- Qwen 3 outperforms Gemini 2.5 Pro and O3 Mini in benchmarks like Aimeme 24 and 25, especially in coding and agentic tasks.
- It has improved agentic capabilities, supports 119 languages, and offers enhanced programming abilities.
- Qwen 3's dataset has been significantly expanded, using both web and PDF sources, with additional data from synthetic code and math data generation.
- The training process involves three stages, including reinforcement learning and combining thinking and non-thinking modes for better performance.
- The model is open-source under the Apache 2.0 license, allowing for commercial use and modification, promoting research and product development.

comments.text: Dense is just one chunky model of six dense chunky models.  Dense is the opposite of MOE. These are organized in latent spaces—vector fields of conceptual proximity, not grammatical flow. The result often appears as "alien" AI  language  until you recognize that meaning is assembled, not narrated.  The alien language to assemble it is unknown to us.  Can't read it yet but  will be revealed as pre-existing like math as we learn more recursively about  its mysterious higher level symbolic  language concepts.

:yt: :stopwatch-blue-hand-timer: TIMESTAMPS & Summary: Qwen 3 is a new Chinese open-source AI model family, featuring a flagship 235B parameter model using a mixture of experts approach, that competes with top-tier models like DeepSeek R1 and Gemini 2.5 Pro, excelling in coding and agentic tasks while supporting both thinking and non-thinking modes.
0:01 🚀 Introducing Qwen 3
• 🤖 Qwen 3 is a new open-source AI model from China, rivaling top models like DeepSeek R1 and Gemini 2.5 Pro.
• 🧠 The flagship model, Qwen 3 235B, uses a mixture of experts approach, activating specific parts of the model based on the query for efficient processing.
• 📊 Benchmarks show Qwen 3 outperforming Gemini 2.5 Pro and O3 Mini in coding and agentic tasks, demonstrating competitive performance.

1:18 🆚 Competitive Performance
• 🏆 Qwen 3 competes with top-tier models like DeepSeek R1, 03 Mini, Gro 3, and Gemini 2.5 Pro, offering extended thinking capabilities.
• 🔀 It supports both thinking (reasoning) and non-thinking modes, switchable to optimize for in-depth analysis or quick responses.
• 🥇 In benchmarks, Qwen 3 rivals or beats Gemini 2.5 Pro and 03 Mini in live code bench and code forces, excelling in mathematical competitions like Aimeme 24 and 25.

3:00 Open Source Availability
• ⚙️ Six dense models, ranging from 6 billion to 32 billion parameters, will be open-weighted, contrasting the mixture of experts approach.
• 🌐 Models are available on HuggingFace, Model Scope, and Kaggle, aiming to advance research and deployment of large foundation models.
• 🔑 A developer notes intriguing features not in model cards, suggesting potential breakthroughs in research and product development.

4:18 ✨ Key Features & Capabilities
• 🔄 Key features include thinking and non-thinking modes, allowing the model to reason deeply or provide quick responses as needed.
• 🗣️ It supports 119 languages and dialects with improved agentic capabilities and strengthened support for MCP (Anthropic's model context protocol).
• 📚 Qwen 3's dataset has significantly expanded, using nearly twice the data of Qwen 2.5, including web, PDF, and synthetic code/math data generated by previous models.

7:19 🔬 Training Process
• 🧪 Pre-training occurs in three stages: initial training on 30 trillion tokens, improved knowledge-intensive data, and extension of context length to 32 trillion tokens.
• 💡 Post-training involves long chain of thought cold start, reasoning reinforcement learning, thinking mode fusion, and general reinforcement learning.
• 🎓 Lightweight models are trained using strong-to-weak distillation, leveraging outputs from larger models to create efficient, specialized models usable on edge devices.

9:46 ⚙️ Fine-Tuning Stages
• 🎯 Stage one fine-tunes models using diverse long chain of thought data to equip them with fundamental reasoning abilities.
• 🚀 Stage two scales up computational resources for reinforcement learning, enhancing the model's exploration and exploitation capabilities.
• 🤝 Stage three integrates non-thinking capabilities into the thinking model, blending reasoning and quick response capabilities for seamless performance.

11:54 🤝 Open Development and Future Vision
• 📰 Developers are sharing new tricks and strategies in blog posts and a forthcoming paper to foster innovation and replication of results.
• 🤖 General reinforcement learning is used to improve instruction following, format adherence, and agent capabilities.
• 🔮 The team believes AI is transitioning from training models to training agents, promising meaningful advancements for work and life.
